festivals.label: Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết 2027

sections.core: Earned cash (vendors, parking, carnival) covers most of core ({preSponsor} of {coreTarget}). Sponsor a core gift below to close the remaining gap — each unlocks stories for social posting.
sections.registry: Sponsors close the core ops gap first (planning $20,104 after earned cash — Festival Foundation + Main Stage earmarks; not the full core face), then unlock High Priority: Saturday’s theatrical day, Sunday’s Tết Tailgate (Super Bowl), family moments both days, and the Weather / Cancel Fund. Electives (including Yearbook) are optional stories we may not lead with in asks.
sections.registryPriority: Family linger, Saturday stage stories, and Sunday Tết Tailgate screens — still sponsor-funded, with no funding guarantee.
sections.registryElective: Optional stories — stage performances, creator meet & greets, Relay Cup, beer garden, elders, décor accents, and more. Funded items run; unfunded ones wait.
sections.tiers: Recognition levels based on your total sponsorship. Tier benefits stack with any registry stories you fund — your build highlights the tier you reach.
sections.options: Sponsor booth spot unlocks at Bronze ($3,000+). Bring your own tent, or add Premium Tent Rental. Premium Tent Rental requires sponsor booth spot.
